text:
maria: Quick thought — we need a way to chain filters in Console analytics so users can compose per-route + per-model + rollout_tag filters. Current saved queries feel flat. cc @kevin @alyssa :thinking_face:
kevin: +1. Main UX q: do we show filter pills as AND chain by default? Or let users pick AND/OR per pill? AND seems simpler but OR useful for model variants.
alyssa: prefer AND default. OR can be an advanced toggle. Also telemetry scoping matters — metric rollups should respect the composite filters, not just route or model separately.
sam: telemetry side: current backend API only supports a single scope param (route_id OR model_id). We'll need to extend to a multi-dim filter set. Can we reuse /v1/metrics/query with a body like: `POST /v1/metrics/query { "filters": [{"k":"route_id","v":"r-123"}, {"k":"model_slug","v":"m-7b-q4"}], "group_by": ["model_slug"] }`
maria: yeah that's the debate. I don't want Console to invent another query language. @kevin can platform support that POST shape without huge perf hit?
kevin: we can, but indexing for (route_id, model_slug, rollout_tag) increases cardinality. Proposal: adaptive path — if filter set is single-dim -> use precomputed rollups; if mixed multi-dim -> fall back to live compute with smart sampling and cached partials.
noah: UX note — saved filters should reference named entities (route alias, model slug) not opaque IDs. Shareable links must be human-readable.
alyssa: +1. Also surface cost/calls breakdown in the view header. Users will ask "what's the cost impact of this saved view?"
maria: can we show a small preview of expected token cost (7d avg) when saving a filter? Might reuse the telemetry summary endpoint.
deploy-bot: analytics-query-api v2 deployed to staging at 1917999900 — tests passing, no downtime reported. :white_check_mark:
sam: linking design/tech doc: https://notes/redwood/AN-342 — I'll prototype the API shape and include perf tests. If team ok, I'll open a PR the week after.
alyssa: quick followup on sharing/permissions — saved filters should inherit project/team visibility and honor org-level private/public flags. Add to requirements.
kevin: I'll sketch indexing/rollup plan and ping infra for capacity estimate.
maria: thanks all. I'll add this to the product board and wireframe the pill UX. If anyone strongly objects to AND-as-default speak now :slightly_smiling_face:
